verdict.rationale: Gladia's homepage claims "100% EU data residency," so customer data is kept in a defined region. Nothing in the evidence shows a user can choose among regions, for example per account or per request, so the story's "choose" element is unproven and the claim rests on a single marketing line. Missing for 10: user-selectable region or residency configuration, documentation of available regions and how to select them, technical docs on storage location and retention by region, independent corroboration.
